description: California SoS Business Scraper - Agent & Status. Scrape the California Secretary of State business registry (bizfileOnline): entity name, number, status, standing, type, formation date and registered agent. Search by name or entity number. The registry returns at most 500 matches for a term - a list that hits that ceiling is reported as INCOMPLETE, so a missing entity is not proof it is unregistered; narrow the term and re-run. No API key needed. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

includeNameReservations.description: Name reservations share the number sequence but are not formed businesses. Off by default: they are skipped and not billed.
includeNameReservations.title: Include name reservations

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxNumbersPerRun.description: Upper bound on how many entity numbers one run checks. California issues roughly 1,500-2,000 per business day; a daily schedule at the default keeps up, and whatever is not reached is picked up next run.
maxNumbersPerRun.title: Entity numbers to check per run

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of entities to keep per query (default 50 to avoid surprise charges on broad searches). Set 0 for no limit (all matches, typically up to ~500 per search).
maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query

mode.description: Search looks up the names or entity numbers you list below. New filings delivers every newly approved California entity since the last run - schedule it daily and each run picks up where the previous one stopped. Add addresses takes the results of an earlier run and completes each record with its principal address, mailing address and the registered agent's address.
mode.title: What to do

reserveForNewNumbers.description: Every run re-checks numbers that had no record yet before it moves on to new ones. This reserves part of the run's budget for new numbers so the scan always moves forward, even when the re-check queue is long. Leave at the default unless a run reports a growing backlog.
reserveForNewNumbers.title: Look-ups reserved for new entity numbers

restartFromStartNumber.description: Discard the saved position and start again from "Start from entity number". Use it to re-run a range; every record in it is delivered (and billed) again.
restartFromStartNumber.title: Restart from the start number

searchQueries.description: Company names or entity/file numbers to look up in the California Secretary of State business registry. Each query returns all matching entities.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sourceDatasetId.description: The dataset ID of an earlier run of this actor. Every record in it is looked up once and returned with principalAddress, mailingAddress, agentType, agentName and agentAddress added. Commercial registered agents have no address of their own on the entity's record, so agentAddress is empty for those.
sourceDatasetId.title: Results to complete (dataset ID)

sourceRunId.description: Alternative to the dataset ID: the ID of the earlier run whose results should be completed.
sourceRunId.title: ...or the run ID

startEntityNumber.description: New filings only, first run only: the California entity number to start from, e.g. B20260403469. Later runs continue automatically from the saved position.
startEntityNumber.title: Start from entity number

stateStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store in your Apify account that keeps the scan position between runs. Use a different name to run several independent feeds.
stateStoreName.title: Progress store name

stopAfterConsecutiveMisses.description: How many consecutive entity numbers with no approved filing yet mark the end of what the registry has processed so far. Leave at the default unless a run stops too early.
stopAfterConsecutiveMisses.title: Stop after consecutive unanswered numbers

name: regdata_california_sos_business
